text:
How to download an IPA file? (ONLY FOR IOS!!!)
1. Go to

site (you can click on the link)
2. Click blue button “AppleJr DNS”
3. Go to the settings of your phone. Click the “General”, then “VPN, DNS & Device Management” and click “AppleJR” and “Install” or “Download”
4. Go to the “AppleJR” app. Find ESign (I used v5.0.2 - China + DNS) and click “Install now”
5. Open the “Esign” app (if it’s does NOT opening), then go to the settings again. “General” -> “VPN, DNS & Device Management”, and then click “China Telecommunications Corporation”, then click “Trust” and then your phone will reboot
6. Then turn on your phone, go to “AppleJR” app and click “Certificate” and save the file
7. Go to “Esign” app, click the •••, then click “Import”, find your the file “

”, click on it
8. Now click on the file again and click “Unzip”. Then go to the “ChinaTelecom” folder. Click on the “cert.p12”, then “Import Certificate Management”, write the password: WSF, click Ok
9. Click the ••• and “Import”, find an IPA file of your game
10. Go to “Apps”, click on the game, click “Signature”. Turn “Install after signed” on. Then click “Signature”
11. Congratulations, you downloaded the game

7. Go to “Esign” app, click the •••, then click “Import”, find your the file “

”, click on it
8. Now click on the file again and click “Unzip”. Then go to the “ChinaTelecom” folder. Click on the “cert.p12”, then “Import Certificate Management”, write the password: WSF, click Ok
9. Click the ••• and “Import”, find an IPA file of your game
10. Go to “Apps”, click on the game, click “Signature”. Turn “Install after signed” on. Then click “Signature”
11. Congratulations, you downloaded the game
